findings.title: Older layout saves fail to resume merged exercises after pruning
findings.cause: The fallback to deletionResumeTitles is gated on layout=placement-v1. When pruning merges two exercises, the original 28 set exercise 9-1/9-2 and 42 set exercise 1-1/1-2 titles disappear. Older heads-v3, heads-v3-editorial-20260925 and topics-v4 saves then match neither the old-layout metadata nor current titles, leaving start=0.
findings.reproduction: Write {lid:'28세트',title:'Exercise 9-1 · 2764~2773',layout:'topics-v4'} to goyang-hoe-last-v1 and use empty progress. resumeTarget returns 0세트 Exercise 1 · 인사와 나·너 instead of 28세트 Exercise 9 · 2764~2773. The same happens for 28 set Exercise 9-2 and 42 set Exercise 1-1/1-2, with all three older layouts.
findings.evidence: Obtained the actual saveLast() JSON from historic runtimes 71c3502 (heads-v3), 4b6807f (heads-v3-editorial-20260925), 7f38a09 and cadd4fb (topics-v4), then passed those JSON strings to the current runtime. All 16 tested real saves resumed at set 0. A wider candidate comparison found exactly 12 affected combinations across the three layouts and four titles.
findings.impact: Users returning after not opening the latest placement-v1 build lose their last-exercise route and resume from the first unfinished exercise, often the beginning of the course. Saved cards and completed-exercise records themselves are preserved.
findings.recommendation: After older-layout-specific mapping has failed, allow pre-pruning saves from these older layouts to use deletionResumeTitles too, while preserving newer prune-marked saves and earlier mapping precedence. Add real historical save fixtures to prune.test.cjs.
findings.testGap: pipeline/tests/prune.test.cjs:73 tests only layout=placement-v1. set0.test.cjs tests legacy layouts only for sets 0, 1 and 5; it also runs the prior DATA under current code. Existing tests therefore do not cover this 28/42 merged-title regression.
